deal_notes:
Background:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building conversational support + contextual search for customer success and knowledge discovery.
- Current stack: React frontend + Python microservices, data in AWS (us-east-1).
- Started with Hosted API PoC in Jan 2026 (2-week proof of concept around chat + reranking).

Engagement history / timeline:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (Jordan) — product goals, latency targets (95p < 200ms for chat).
- 2026-01-18: Hosted API POC kicked off; ingest pipeline for embeddings set up by Archipelago infra.
- 2026-01-28: Fireflies call ff_2026-02-28_0192 — demo of Hosted results; team impressed with generation quality but needs lower tail latency.
- 2026-02-10: Request for Dedicated pricing after seeing token-level economics on hosted.
- 2026-02-20: Architecture call with SE (Priya) — outlined Dedicated (VPC) topology and autoscale options.
- 2026-02-28: Security sync (ff_2026-02-28_0192) — Archipelago security want SOC2 report, SSO/SAML integration plan (Okta), audit log retention policy (12 months), and KMS integration options.
- 2026-03-05: SE follow-up demo (ff_2026-03-05_0247) — discussed caching, prefix KV, and quantization trade-offs to lower per-token cost.
- 2026-03-08: Internal econ review at Archipelago; asked for Dedicated network diagram + procurement SOW.

Technical / requirements summary:
- Workloads: chat (multi-turn), embeddings (doc-search), reranking for relevance pipeline.
- Latency: target 95th percentile < 200ms for chat; sub-50ms for embedding lookups (end-to-end).
- Throughput: peak 80 rps for chat inference; 200 qps for embeddings retrieval.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — prioritize predictable unit economics via Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Model preferences: open-models with MPT/LLAMA variants acceptable; want Redwood-verified performance profiles.
- Routing/fallback: need automated fallback to smaller model family if Dedicated capacity constrained.

Security & compliance specifics:
- Must be able to run Dedicated inside customer VPC (no public endpoints).
- SOC2 Type II attestation is a gating factor for procurement. Archipelago asked for last 12 months of SOC2 report excerpts.
- SSO via Okta using SAML; SCIM for provisioning preferred.
- Audit logs: retention 12 months, exportable to customer Splunk/CloudWatch; fine-grained token-level audit required.
- Data residency: primary in us-east-1, option to limit storage/kv to region.
- KMS: allow customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM) for encryption at rest.
- Retention controls: ability to set automatic deletion windows for user-provided docs & embeddings.

POC / Pilot plan discussed:
- Short Dedicated pilot (4 weeks): provision 2-node Dedicated pool in VPC, run mirrored traffic for a subset of users, validate latency/throughput and billing estimates.
- Deliverables: VPC network diagram, security checklist (answers + artifacts), performance runbook, Dedicated pricing sheet.

Pricing/discussion notes:
- Archipelago requested committed monthly capacity pricing + burst rates.
- Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization) to reduce cost per token.
- Legal asked for standard DPA + clause for data deletion on termination.

Customer quotes / voice:
- "We need predictable tail latency for multi-turn support flows — unclear if hosted meets our SLOs under peak." — Head of Product.
- "SOC2 is non-negotiable for our enterprise customers; we need artifacts before procurement." — Security lead.

Next steps (short list):
- 1) Send Dedicated pricing + SOW (Jordan) by 2026-03-12. (sent 2026-03-11 draft)
- 2) Schedule security deep-dive with Redwood infra & Archipelago security (requested week of 2026-03-15).
- 3) Provide VPC network diagram + peering checklist and sample firewall rules (Priya) by 2026-03-13.
- 4) Support to enable Okta SAML/SCIM integration test instance during pilot.

CRM shorthand / next interactions:
- "security wants SOC2 + KMS options — push on dedicated pilot but don't start procurement until artifacts validated."
- "finance asked for committed 12mo price; flagged to Jordan to escalate to pricing team."
